title: ACAH SARIF property-bag extensions
description: Authoritative ACAH format-v4 contract for custom data stored in SARIF property bags. Use properties.acah at run, rule, result, and thread-flow-location level; older ACAH formats are not supported.

acah.description: ACAH-owned extension. Its shape depends on the SARIF object containing this property bag.

runExtension.description: Run-wide ACAH provenance, coverage, cache, and filtering diagnostics. Viewers normally show this as report metadata rather than as finding columns.

formatVersion.description: ACAH extension contract version. Version 4 introduces producer-independent canonical claims and four application verdicts; older formats are not supported.

engine.description: Optional native evidence producer identifier for a run contributed by a language analyzer.

target.description: Target path recorded by a contributing analyzer. Display only as provenance; artifact URIs remain authoritative finding locations.

report.description: Stable output-report identity and user-facing title.

section.description: Stable section identity used to group runs in unified or split reports.

producer.description: Stable identity of the analysis producer or rule source represented by this run.

runTitle.description: User-facing run title combining the stable section and producer titles.

nativeAnalysis.description: Per-language native analyzer coverage and outcome. Use this to expose analysis gaps; never infer that no findings means analysis succeeded.

dependencyAnalysis.description: OSV dependency-scan coverage and reachability disclaimer for the dependency report.

publicRuleAnalysis.description: Registry-pack inputs and verification status for public Semgrep findings.

semgrepCache.description: Whether raw Semgrep evidence was scanned or reused. This is provenance, not finding confidence.

registryRuleCache.description: How Semgrep registry packs were resolved and whether cached rule snapshots were fresh, refreshed, stale, or bypassed.

scanConfiguration.description: Explicit scan scope that affects target and rule selection. Display path exclusions prominently when explaining coverage.

workspaceDiagnostics.description: Human-readable analyzer coverage/build diagnostics. Current combined reports retain this detailed list only on the primary run; show it once in a report-level diagnostics panel.

testSourcePartition.description: Counts and origin for findings moved between production and test-source reports.

filteredStaleConstruction.description: Construction matches removed because the apparent flow propagated through the sink receiver rather than the sensitive value.

filteredParameterizedSqlFindings.description: Risk matches removed after native evidence proved use of a parameterized SQL API boundary.

filteredTypedSinkMismatches.description: Risk matches removed after native type resolution disproved the expected sink family.

filteredReclassifiedInventoryDuplicates.description: Inventory matches removed because a more accurately typed sink record covers the same operation.

filteredProcessStartInfoOverlaps.description: Generic process-executable or construction matches removed because typed ProcessStartInfo configuration and execution records preserve the correct field roles. Argument-only web flow is not promoted to executable taint.

filteredRedundantWrapperCandidates.description: Wrapper findings removed because a deeper proven flow already contains the same handoff.

filteredRedundantReviewCandidates.description: Construction-only review findings removed because an exact-location public Pro taint flow proves the same vulnerability family.

ruleExtension.description: Rule-level default semantics. Result-level ACAH data is authoritative when both are present.

category.description: Original Semgrep category retained for filtering public rules.

subcategory.description: Original Semgrep subcategories retained for filtering public rules.

technology.description: Framework/language tags supplied by the rule author.

cwe.description: CWE identifiers supplied by the rule author; not proof of exploitability.

owasp.description: OWASP category tags supplied by the rule author.

resultExtension.description: Finding classification and native evidence used for prioritization. Canonical application findings also carry claim and detectedBy; status is their authoritative verdict. Viewers should primarily show status, claim reason, detector provenance, sinkFamily, trace, source/origin, and resolution; deeper evidence belongs in an expandable details view.

originalClassification.description: Classification before native promotion, downgrade, or disproof. Use for audit history, not current severity.

claim.description: Canonical security claim represented by this result. Required on final application findings after canonicalization; absent on inventory, dependency, and test-only records that do not represent a canonical application claim.

detectedBy.description: Every analyzer or rule observation consolidated into this canonical claim. Producer and rule identity are provenance only and never determine the claim verdict.

semgrepLevel.description: Original Semgrep SARIF level preserved when ACAH changes the displayed level.

valuePreview.description: Optional bounded value preview from native analysis. Treat as potentially sensitive source data.

nativeResolution.description: Native analyzer mechanism that classified the value.

nativeReason.description: Human-readable explanation for the native value classification.

sanitizerEvidence.description: Exact configured sanitizer proofs that directly supplied sensitive sink values.

summaryEvidence.description: Exact configured opaque-boundary sink declarations matched by native analysis.

nativeVerification.description: Public-rule adapter outcome such as confirmed, reviewed-construction, constant, validated, disproved, or review.

metadataClassification.description: Classification derived only from public-rule metadata before native verification.

duplicateOccurrences.description: Number of deep-equal dependency result rows removed while retaining this representative result. Absent when no duplicate was removed.

scope.description: Source scope. test means the finding was confidently assigned to the separate test-source report.

section.description: Section inherited from the containing report run; use this when results are indexed without run context.

supportingConstruction.description: Lower-priority construction evidence folded into a stronger source-to-sink result or a dominant same-sink construction variant.

confirmedWrapperHandoffs.description: Confirmed wrapper evidence correlated with a deeper raw-sink flow and suppressed as a duplicate.

category.description: Original Semgrep category for public-rule review.

technology.description: Technology tags from the originating rule.

cwe.description: CWE tags from the originating rule.

owasp.description: OWASP tags from the originating rule.

traceStepExtension.description: Semantic role for a SARIF thread-flow location. Viewers should use this to color and label source, propagation, boundary, and sink steps.

symbol.description: Exact identifier represented by the step when the producer can resolve it. The SARIF region and state should select the same symbol.

resolution.description: Analyzer or model that assigned the role/symbol.

id.description: Stable machine-readable report identity. Use for report-level filtering.

title.description: User-facing report title. Use for the report heading.

id.description: Stable machine-readable section identity. Use for section filtering and persistence.

title.description: User-facing section title. Use for run and group headings.

order.description: Ascending display order for sections within a report.

title.description: Short user-facing producer title appended to the section heading.

classification.description: ACAH queue category. Proven flows use taint-high-confidence or security-high-confidence; unresolved flows use taint-unverified/taint-candidate; inventories and public/official adapter classifications retain their explicit names.

status.description: Current ACAH disposition. Canonical application claims use proven, plausible, unknown, or disproven. Other values are accepted only on noncanonical analyzer evidence, inventory, or dependency results.

id.description: Stable producer-independent SHA-256 claim identity. Final SARIF repeats this value as partialFingerprints acahClaim/v1.

vulnerabilityClass.description: Normalized security claim family used for canonical rule identity and equivalence, such as sql-injection or cross-site-scripting.

reason.description: Concise explanation for the current status verdict. Display beside or immediately below the verdict.

validationConflict.description: True only when applicable validators produced contradictory conclusions. Conflicted claims use plausible status.

id.description: Stable identifier for this detector observation within the canonical claim.

producer.description: Analyzer or rule-source identity that emitted the original result.

originalFingerprint.description: Best original result fingerprint before canonicalization.

classification.description: Original ACAH or detector classification retained for provenance and rule-quality analysis.

codeFlowIndices.description: Zero-based indices into the canonical result codeFlows that preserve this observation's distinct trace evidence.

confidence.description: Producer confidence label, normally HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, UNSPECIFIED, or UNVERIFIED. Use status and SARIF level/kind as the primary queue controls.

sinkFamily.description: Normalized operation family such as SQL, filesystem, process execution, SSRF, deserialization, or cryptography.

status.description: Whether the eventual security-sensitive effect is unresolved, matched by a static model, or confirmed by native endpoint resolution.

kind.description: Expected or resolved effect family, such as sql-execution or raw-html-output.

reason.description: Why ACAH assigned the effect status.

construction.description: How the sensitive value was built, for example untrusted-input, concatenated, interpolated, observable-result, or unresolved.

resolution.description: Model/analyzer decision that produced the current classification. This is concise provenance, not a user-facing explanation by itself.

verification.description: Whether a public finding was independently verified. unverified must never be displayed as proven.

reachability.description: Call/dependency reachability state. unverified or not established means presence only.

valueOrigin.description: Native classification of the value reaching the operation. Constant/generated/trusted/constrained values can clear construction noise; constrained means a conversion limits the output alphabet but does not prove authorization. Dynamic does not imply attacker control.

status.description: complete means all endpoints required by ACAH's bounded model are represented; it is not runtime exploit proof.

scope.description: Whether the code flow ends at unresolved dangerous construction or at a modeled security-sensitive effect, and whether it begins at construction or at a recognized untrusted/modelled source.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why the trace is complete or partial.

path.description: Artifact path or URI as recorded by the analyzer.

endLine.description: One-based inclusive source line containing the exclusive end column.

endColumn.description: One-based exclusive end column used to highlight the exact symbol/expression.

logicalName.description: Semantic fully qualified name of the containing callable, when resolved by a native analyzer.

originEvidence.description: Earliest boundary ACAH can prove when no recognized untrusted caller source is available. An unresolved method parameter is a review boundary, not taint proof.

symbol.description: Fully qualified semantic symbol when resolved.

trust.description: Trust conclusion; unresolved means the caller was not established.

resolution.description: Native mechanism that found the boundary.

sourceEvidence.description: Native evidence for a recognized framework input endpoint.

classification.description: Source family, such as ASP.NET request input or servlet binding.

receiverType.description: Resolved receiver type for a source method/property.

valueType.description: Resolved type of the value leaving the source.

operationKind.description: Source syntax/semantic operation, such as parameter-reference or method-invocation.

sourceBinding.description: Framework binding annotation/attribute that corroborates an endpoint parameter as input.

commandHandoff.description: Bounded native trace through a command/dispatcher/handler pattern.

reason.description: Why the handoff was confirmed or left unresolved.

serviceSymbol.description: Optional concrete service method reached from the handler.

serviceParameter.description: Optional service parameter carrying the value.

sinkEvidence.description: Native semantic evidence for the security-sensitive operation and each sensitive argument.

sensitiveArgument.description: Zero-based first sensitive argument retained for early consumers.

arguments.description: All security-sensitive arguments, including independent value-origin evidence.

objectUses.description: All locally linked downstream effects on the selected object or resource, ordered by impact.

operationKind.description: Invocation, object creation, assignment, or unresolved syntax kind.

sinkArgument.description: Evidence for one matched sensitive value.

metavar.description: Semgrep metavariable that selected the value.

valueReason.description: Why the argument received its value-origin classification.

valuePreview.description: Optional bounded preview; may contain sensitive source text.

resolution.description: Analyzer mechanism used for argument mapping.

relatedOperation.description: A later execution/object operation linked conservatively within the same local semantic scope.

resolution.description: Linking mechanism, often same-block symbol analysis.

reason.description: Why the operation was or was not linked.

sinkSelection.description: Native check that the textual match is owned by the expected API/framework family.

expectedFamily.description: Sink family expected by the Semgrep rule.

traceSteps.description: Native wrapper steps used to extend an otherwise truncated code flow.

kind.description: Whether the step crosses another wrapper or reaches the concrete sink.

sinkParameterization.description: Native proof about whether a SQL API binds values separately from command text.

status.description: Parameterized clears the SQL construction risk; raw-text does not prove taint.

construction.description: Construction kind contributed by the suppressed result.

resolution.description: How the supporting result was resolved.

valueOrigin.description: Native value origin from the supporting result.

nativeReason.description: Native explanation from the supporting result.

officialNativeEvidence.description: Native evidence retained by the optional official/public-rule adapter. Prefer the result's top-level source and sink fields in the primary ACAH workflow.

sanitizerEvidence.description: Exact configured sanitizer proofs retained from native analysis.

summaryEvidence.description: Exact configured opaque-boundary sink declarations retained from native analysis.

language.description: Language frontend that proved the configured match.

guarantee.description: Narrow security property asserted by this sanitizer declaration.

symbol.description: Exact semantic method symbol selected by the native frontend.

resolution.description: Conservative native data-use pattern that preserved the sanitizer guarantee.

configurationSha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the sanitizer configuration used for this proof.

language.description: Language frontend that matched the declaration.

effect.description: Narrow opaque effect declared by this summary.

symbol.description: Exact semantic method symbol selected by the native frontend.

sensitiveParameter.description: Zero-based parameter declared as the sensitive sink value.

configurationSha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the summary configuration used for this match.

wrapperHandoff.description: A confirmed wrapper result retained as supporting evidence on a deeper source-to-sink result.

supportingConstruction.description: Construction evidence originally attached to the wrapper result.

confidence.description: Only high-confidence test detection is partitioned.

language.description: Language whose test-layout conventions were applied.

reasons.description: Concrete path/project/attribute evidence for test classification.

status.description: Coverage outcome shown to the auditor.

workspaceDiagnostics.description: Optional language-specific build/load diagnostics retained by raw analyzer evidence. Final reports keep compact language status here and place detailed diagnostics once on the primary run.

reachability.description: Explicit statement that vulnerable call reachability was or was not established.

duplicateResultsRemoved.description: Count of deep-equal OSV result rows removed from this run. Results that differ in any evidence field remain separate.

triggerLanguages.description: Language selections that caused registry packs to be included.

registryConfigs.description: Registry config names used by the scan.

excludedRuleIds.description: Exact registry rule IDs omitted from this scan. Display in run diagnostics when nonempty.

verification.description: Overall verification policy. Individual results remain review items unless an allow-listed native adapter confirms both source and sink.

status.description: hit reused evidence; miss scanned and stored it; refreshed bypassed an existing entry; no-rules produced empty evidence.

key.description: Content-addressed key over target state, languages/configs, local rule contents, Semgrep version/binary, and scan flags.

semgrepVersion.description: Semgrep CLI version included in the cache key.

reused.description: True only when raw evidence came from a complete cache entry.

mode.description: cached uses local authenticated snapshots; mixed combines cached snapshots with live fallbacks for individual unavailable packs; live bypasses the pack cache by configuration; live-fallback means every requested cached pack had to use the registry directly; not-applicable means no registry pack was selected.

status.description: Overall registry pack resolution outcome. Partial means at least one selected pack used a live fallback; inspect each pack status.

packs.description: Resolved pack snapshots. Empty when live registry loading was used or no packs applied.

languages.description: Resolved language selection used for this scan.

registryPacks.description: Selected Semgrep registry pack identifiers before cache resolution.

excludedRuleIds.description: Exact public registry rule IDs intentionally excluded from the scan.

excludedPaths.description: User-supplied path or glob exclusions. Generated exclusions for ACAH output and cache directories are not included.

sha256.description: Digest of the exact sanitizer configuration used for native classification.

ids.description: Sorted user-defined sanitizer identifiers loaded for this scan.

sha256.description: Digest of the exact summary configuration used for native matching.

ids.description: Sorted user-defined summary identifiers loaded for this scan.

path.description: Private local snapshot path, or the registry identifier when this pack used a live fallback.

sha256.description: Snapshot content digest included in the raw-evidence cache key. Empty only for a live fallback without a local snapshot.

etag.description: Registry HTTP validator when supplied by Semgrep.

status.description: How this pack was resolved for the current scan. Live-fallback means Semgrep loaded the registry identifier because no local snapshot was available.
separated describes a production report; test-only describes a run copied into the test report.

movedFindings.description: Findings removed from this production report.

sourceReport.description: Risk or inventory report from which a test-only run originated.

findingCount.description: Findings contained in the test-only run.

filteredFindings.description: Diagnostic records for findings intentionally removed from the visible queue. Preserve for transparency; viewers may summarize counts and expose details on demand.

filteredFinding.description: Union of fields used by run-level filtering diagnostics.

expectedFamily.description: Sink family expected by the textual rule.

actualFamily.description: Sink family established by native analysis.

actualSymbol.description: Resolved symbol that disproved or reclassified the match.

actualReceiverType.description: Resolved receiver type that disproved or reclassified the match.

supersededByRuleId.description: Higher-confidence rule identifier that made this review-only finding redundant.
